statusDetail: The target is inaccessible from the audit environment: CloudFront returned HTTP 403 to both browser and direct HTTP requests. No application-quality judgement is possible.

page.notes: Only a CloudFront 403 error document was reachable. The target application profile and representative route set could not be established.
